title: nproc -J record
description: The single record of `nproc -J`. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

processors.description: What nproc prints: the processing units available, after --all, --ignore and OMP_NUM_THREADS / OMP_THREAD_LIMIT.
